# Dither

Reduces each channel to a few levels and hides the banding with a dither pattern: ordered Bayer matrices, void-and-cluster blue noise, or interleaved gradient noise.

<EffectDemo effect="dither" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { dither } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/dither';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(dither({ preset: 'gameboy' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.pattern = 'bayer4'`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter   | Type                                                       | Default         | Range    | Description                                                                                                               |
| ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | --------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pattern`   | 'bayer2' \| 'bayer4' \| 'bayer8' \| 'blueNoise' \| 'noise' | `'bayer4'`      |          | Threshold pattern: Bayer matrices give a regular cross-hatch, blue noise an even grain, noise a cheap texture-free grain. |
| `levels`    | integer                                                    | `4`             | 2 – 32   | Values per channel after quantizing.                                                                                      |
| `scale`     | number                                                     | `2`             | 1 – 8 px | Size of a dither cell.                                                                                                    |
| `grayscale` | boolean                                                    | `false`         |          | Dither brightness only, for a one-color look.                                                                             |
| `amount`    | number                                                     | `1`             | 0 – 1    | Mix between the original and the dithered image.                                                                          |
| `noise`     | 2D texture or 'blueNoise64'                                | `'blueNoise64'` |          | Blue-noise threshold map used by the blue-noise pattern.                                                                  |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset      | Settings                                                           |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `gameboy`   | `pattern: 'bayer4'`, `levels: 4`, `grayscale: true`, `scale: 3`    |
| `blueNoise` | `pattern: 'blueNoise'`, `levels: 3`, `scale: 2`                    |
| `fine`      | `pattern: 'bayer8'`, `levels: 6`, `scale: 1`                       |
| `oneBit`    | `pattern: 'blueNoise'`, `levels: 2`, `grayscale: true`, `scale: 2` |

Apply one with `dither({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Retro & display · tracked as story X7.2 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** reads only its own pixel, so it merges into the pass before it.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 7.9 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/dither`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Bayer, An optimum method for two-level rendition of continuous-tone pictures, 1973; Ulichney, The void-and-cluster method for dither array generation, SPIE 1993; Jimenez, Next Generation Post Processing in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare, SIGGRAPH 2014 (interleaved gradient noise).
